Overdue

', join(body('LateRows'),''), '
TaskCandidateDue
'), ''), if(greater(length(body('Soon')),0), concat('

Due in the next 7 days

', join(body('SoonRows'),''), '
TaskCandidateDue
'), ''), '

')

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat('A reminder from UAB OBGYN onboarding: ', items('Each_Touch')?['Title'])

@concat('

Hello ', replace(replace(replace(coalesce(first(body('CandRow'))?['Title'],''),'&','&'),'<','<'),'>','>'), ',

— UAB Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology

')

@concat('
